readingReviewNotes: Eight original passages, six ordinary and two assessment; each has two paragraphs and two evidence-linked questions.
Corrected 返事を待つ to planned self-reply after work confirmation, and corrected attribution/appearance wording.
Photograph spelling differences support a possibility, not independently confirmed dating. Strong phrasing does not create new evidence.
Reused Vます-stem＋方, Vます-stem＋直す, adjective＋さ and 最終＋的に; required previously taught structures are declared. No derived forms are counted as new roots.
Avoided hidden unintroducedN2ものの、てこそ、を問わず and おそれがある, retaining the intended contrast, condition and uncertainty in taught forms.
Added the actual rewriting event before a critic evaluates that rewriting; source confirmation, interpretation and evaluation remain distinct.
乗り場 is separately taught as an earlier N5 foundation because an old N5 駅員 example already used it; only the reviewed itemID is changed.
All Chinese, contexts, questions and distractors are project-authored. Selected semantic facts do not constitute independent language review.
